sentence: This project builds software that automatically designs microfluidic devices to be made by 3D printing for medical tests and drug discovery.
This project studies how the pace of life of animals affects predator and prey interactions, food webs, and whole ecosystems using models and activity data.
This project creates modules that connect quantum computing with healthcare problems such as molecular modeling and protein structure prediction.
This project studies how all-female salamanders cope with mitochondrial and nuclear genomes that conflict, by measuring sequence evolution, mitochondrial performance, and whole-animal metabolism.
This project studies how graph neural networks work and when their results can be trusted, using experiments and statistics.
This project studies how the body sizes of individuals in streams and rivers explain how energy flows through ecosystems.
This project tries to find out how urban habitats affect horseshoe crabs by comparing urban, undeveloped, and offshore populations.
This project studies how barriers to interbreeding build up and work together as species form in the corn borer moth.
This project builds open-source software that helps developers create reliable cyber-physical systems, which combine software with physical-world processes.
This project studies attacks on quantum machine learning models run on untrusted cloud services and builds ways to protect them from theft.
This project studies how a virus that lives inside fruit flies spreads within a host population and jumps into other host species.
This project studies how a parasite switches its surface proteins when it moves from the bloodstream of a mammal to the gut of a fly.
This project brings researchers together at a workshop to share ideas and discuss research problems in cybersecurity.
This project builds AI systems that recognize a person's lower limb joint efforts so robotic exoskeletons can be controlled across many daily tasks.
This project studies why single-photon emitters in boron nitride and quantum dots lose coherence, using a type of spectroscopy based on quantum optics.
This project develops courses on network forensics and big data analytics for better understanding of malware threats.
This project studies how using a laser to foam polymer composites in selected places changes their mechanical, thermal, and electrical properties.
